title: Execute numeric memory records through the CUDA adapter
problem: CUDA stdout can succeed while numeric conversion or bounded output counts in accelerator memory are wrong.
example:
cudaMemcpyHostToDevice -> memory_kernel -> cudaDeviceSynchronize
-> cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost -> serialize(input, output)
design: Allocate CUDA input/output buffers, copy input encodings, zero output, launch memory_kernel, check errors/synchronize, and copy framed results back. The numeric formatting body remains the shared handwritten template.
tradeoffs: Runtime execution remains hardware-dependent; source-generation and host record tests validate structure but do not establish accelerator execution.
docs: The memory launcher formats on the selected backend and copies records to the host for byte-exact oracle comparison. Stdout control failure does not hide memory outcomes.
